scopeNote: Covers properties inside the City of Scottsdale. Neighboring Maricopa County cities such as Phoenix, Mesa and Tempe, and unincorporated county areas, keep their own records.

violations.coverage: Scottsdale code complaints received since 2021-09, about 18,900 rows. Closed complaints only: open complaints are not published, and every row's status begins with CLOSED. No result means no closed complaint on file, not that the property has no open violation. The street is split across columns: with a house number, '4201 N Hayden Rd' is matched as 4201 on StreetNumber and 'Hayden' on StreetName (one leading direction and one common street type are dropped). Without a house number the name alone gets the same trimming, so 'Hayden Rd' is matched as 'Hayden' on StreetName.

permits.coverage: Scottsdale building permits, about 288,000 issued 1998 to present.

source.name: City of Scottsdale GIS
source.currentRecordsNote: Code complaints and building permits are tables on the City of Scottsdale's own map server. The code-complaint table starts in September 2021 and lists closed complaints only.
